responsibility: Performs MIR type checking for borrow checking by driving the main `TypeChecker` pass over MIR, establishing the free/universal-region environment from signatures and impl bounds, checking input and output locals against normalized and user-provided signature types, relating MIR types and generic arguments under variance, and routing normalization, predicate proving, user-type ascription, and related inference-dependent operations through canonical type-op queries. It converts the resulting outlives information into MIR borrowck region constraints, member constraints, placeholders, and type tests, then computes the liveness constraints that accompany those type constraints by building local def/use/drop maps, extracting Polonius liveness facts, and running backward tracing to determine where regions must be live, so the module as a whole produces the region, liveness, and auxiliary constraint data consumed by later borrow-checking stages.
